text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up: turning the lessons into a small, pragmatic canary fail-safe bundle. Short thread for owners + dates.
sam: I can own auto-rollback (dry-run -> enforced). Will include a simulation mode and a suggestions-only UI first. Target: prototype PR by next Wed.
li: I'll own per-flag scope caps and a migration plan for existing flags. Propose defaults: max_percentage 3%, max_users 200, max_hosts 5.
ryan: Observability: I'll add a "canary health" tile and rollback recommendation annotations. Signals: 5xx rate >0.5% for 3m, p95 >2x for 5m, tenant error concentration > baseline.
tess: I'll implement a pre-ramp smoke suite that runs against canary at 5%. If any probe fails, hold/rollback depending on policy.
security-team: Kill-switch must be vaulted with an ACL role and audit trail. Recommend emergency_two_person_approval for global kills.
marta: Proposed dates: sam -> 2026-04-08, li -> 2026-04-06, ryan -> 2026-04-09, tess -> 2026-04-07, security-team -> 2026-04-05. Confirm?
sam: ack. API sketch (simulation):
POST /rollouts/:id/auto_rollback
{ "enabled": true, "mode": "simulation", "conditions": ["500_rate>0.5%", "p95>2x"], "grace_s": 180 }
li: Blast-radius sample metadata: {"owner":"team-x","max_percentage":3,"max_users":200,"max_hosts":5}
ryan: During simulation show "rollback recommended" annotation and record decisions in a simulation index to measure FP rate.
tess: Test matrix: login, write-critical, read-critical, worker-job. Any fail -> hold at 5%.
marta: I'll open umbrella tickets, link postmortem, and schedule a 30m sync Fri 09:30 to finalize. React :thumbsup: to accept owners.
ryan: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
security-team: acknowledged
deploy-bot: infra/rollout-controller v2.2.5 deploy started
marta: thanks — aiming to close simulation window and iterate quickly based on false-positive analysis. End.
